exposure: patients from counties in which no cesarean deliveries were performed during the quarter of the year when they underwent a cesarean delivery
patients residing in counties where no hospital had a labor and delivery ward
outcome: Cesarean delivery caseload at level III hospitals
Distribution of cesarean deliveries among hospitals
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery in Iowa between October 2015 and June 2021
finding: Patients from counties without labor and delivery services were more likely to have cesarean deliveries at level III hospitals, with a disproportionately higher number going to private level III hospitals compared to the university level III hospital.
mod_finding: Patients residing in counties without labor and delivery care disproportionately go to level III hospitals for cesarean deliveries.
